description: Presidential Secretariat - Presidential Directive for Establish a Special Agency to conduct a study of existing  Salary Structures in Public Service, State  Corporations, Statutory Boards and Government Companies.
reasoning: This gazette establishes a Special Commission to study and make recommendations on public sector salary structures, anomalies, and emoluments across various government services. The content focuses specifically on public service administration, salary revisions, and cadre management, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) covering public service recruitment, service conditions, salary revisions, and administrative circulars. While it involves presidential action and appointments, the core subject matter is public sector salary administration rather than government structure or personnel changes.
